items.why: Reports of Tesla deal talks with SpaceX are one of the big stories on the tape today, and Tesla shares are riding that momentum.
Volatility is falling as the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq all gain and dip buying resumes. A green tape means less fear priced in.
Climbing with the broader AI trade after SpaceX results reignited it, with Super Micro shares also vaulting higher in the headlines.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape as tech rallies and the Nasdaq climbs.

market_note: Dow up about 500 points on earnings optimism; tech leading with Nasdaq higher.
summary: Stocks are rallying midday with the Dow up about 500 points and the VIX down 3.18% as dip buying resumes. Tesla leads the watchlist at 3.63% higher on SpaceX deal-talk headlines, with AMD and Meta climbing on the tech bid while GOOGL lags.
